name: Novena Diabolos
source:
Welcome to Hope Hill Village! One human being who has lost her memory. Four demonesses who are out for blood. One reporter, trying to survive nine days in an isolated village.

This occult survival mystery adventure will have you on your toes from start to finish as you try to solve one crime after the other. You will race against time to save the one human girl trapped among demonesses and gain her trust to finally escape that wretched place called Hope Hill Village. Every playthrough is different in this thrilling visual novel!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1501420/Novena_Diabolos/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到希望山村！一名失去记忆的人类女性。四名嗜血的女恶魔。一名试图在这个与世隔绝的村庄里活过九天的记者。

在这场神秘学题材的生存推理冒险中，你必须接连破解罪案，从头至尾都无法松懈。你将与时间赛跑，找出并拯救那个混在女恶魔之间、受困于此的人类女孩，赢得她的信任，最终逃离这座名为希望山村的可憎之地。在这部惊险的视觉小说中，每次游玩的经历都不相同！

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1501420/Novena_Diabolos/]Steam[/url]]
